title: The Full View description
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role).
custom_steps:
1. Select Full View.
  2. Read the description shown for it.
custom_expected: The Full View description explains it is the complete interface with all fields visible and editable (subject to the add/edit/delete permissions), the estimate column shows the actual estimate value, the full parts request form is shown, and all workflow actions (approve, review, split, and so on) are available.
evidence: UI: Full View description reads "Complete interface with all fields visible and editable (subject to CRUD permissions). The estimate column shows the actual estimate value. Full parts request form with all fields. All workflow actions available (approve, review, split etc...)."
